name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.BasicCategoryTheory
paperMapping: Primary 1.5 and 1.11: non-exercise identity laws and inverse uniqueness. Assigned exercise solutions are withheld.

name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.CategoryConstructions
paperMapping: Primary 1.5–1.13, 1.18, 1.20, 1.22, 3.2 and 3.5: ordinary definitions, examples and supplied laws. Assigned construction checks are withheld.

name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.CategorySize
paperMapping: Primary 1.4, 1.8 and 1.16: type-universe size and local smallness. These are explicitly scoped type-theoretic formulations, not a literal ZFSet encoding of all categories.

name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.PathAndIdentity
paperMapping: Introduction: endpoint-fixed path homotopies, their ordinary fundamental groupoid, and group invariants. This does not construct the full infinity-groupoid or prove univalence.

name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetUniverses
paperMapping: Primary 1.1–1.4: ZFSet universe closure assumptions and consequences. Introduction: equality substitution and transport. Universe existence is assumed, not proved.

name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SourceLaws
paperMapping: Primary 1.9, 1.18, 3.1 and 3.6: definitions and their supplied laws; no assigned exercise construction checks.

name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.TerminalCategory
paperMapping: Primary 1.25, 1.27, 3.8 and 3.9: terminal category and finite example. The strict evaluation isomorphism assigned in 1.26 is withheld.

name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.WalkingIsomorphism
paperMapping: Primary 1.25, 3.4, 3.8 and 3.9: one-object and two-object singleton-hom categories, an explicit adjoint equivalence and two-object cardinality.

name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.YonedaAdjunction
paperMapping: Primary 2.3, the non-assigned part of 2.6, 2.7, 3.1 and 3.4–3.7: definitions, non-exercise consequences and equivalence criterion. Assigned Yoneda/adjunction correspondence proofs are withheld.
